title: Construction of ZnS/CdS/Ti3+-TiO2 heterojunction: synergistic enhancement of visible light harvesting and photocathodic protection performance
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,10243-10254
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09129B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wenhao Liu, Yanfeng Zhu, Zhihao Liu, Jianxia Gou
A ZnS/CdS/Ti3+-TiO2 heterojunction film was prepared. This composite film boosts visible-light absorption and charge separation, achieving superior photocathodic protection for 316 stainless steel under simulated sunlight.
